title: Presentation Purpose and Audience
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting presentation purpose and audience to presentation storyboard with audience constraint and slide-level evidence, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Derive a presentation's slide count and slide-level evidence from a named audience's time budget, prior knowledge, and the decision they own.
Justify each slide by the audience question it answers, and identify at least one slide cut because it served no audience question.
Document which AI suggestion (such as adding a metric or a slide) you accepted versus rejected against the audience time budget.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
